verdict.rationale: Riveter's quick_search returns only URLs, titles, and snippets in one synchronous request. Full page text comes from a separate scrape call that turns a URL into parseable text. search_agent and enrichments do run web searches and scrapes internally, but they return an AI-synthesized answer or filled columns, not the full content of the search results. missing for 10: a single-call search that returns full page content per result, documented response format for result page content, hands-on corroboration.
